newsitem.title: USA: BOXING-GOODWILL GAMES BOXING TO BE STAGED ON AIRCRAFT CARRIER.
newsitem.headline: BOXING-GOODWILL GAMES BOXING TO BE STAGED ON AIRCRAFT CARRIER.

text.p: The U.S.S. Intrepid will see its first fighting in decades next year when the retired aircraft carrier serves as the unique site of the boxing competition for the 1998 Goodwill Games.
A temporary 3,300-seat arena will be set up on the enormous flight deck of the carrier, which is docked on the New York side of the Hudson River, Goodwill Gaames president Michael Plant announced.
"It will be a great facility," Plant said of the historic aircraft carrier, which was decommissioned in 1974 and has served as a Sea, Air and Space museum since 1982.
The U.S.S. Intrepid saw extensive action in World War II, including participating in one the war's largest naval engagements -- the battle for Leyte Gulf.
The carrier also saw action during the Vietnam War and was used to retrieve Mercury and Gemini capsules during the fledgling days of the U.S. manned space programme.
The fourth edition of the 12-sport Goodwill Games will take place in New York City and neighbouring Long Island from July 19-August 2, 1998.
